items.q: and there was Jonesy, sitting there, gasping, and I remember taking him and opening the

ctx.x: Jonesy? He -- I think he was an asthmatic, because I remember one night we were on this pullman train, we were on this pullman, and I came -- I woke up in the middle of the night and I climbed down out of the berth and I went in the smoker, and there was Jonesy, sitting there, gasping, and I remember taking him and opening the -- you know, those trains had dutch doors, you opened the -- and sticking his head out the window so he could get this air, you know. He sort of had an attack, you know. So it got worse and…
That was such a big band. Was there much unity in the band or were there little cliques and saxophone players stick together and trumpet players stick together?
